hero.title: The Common Mass Arts (TCM Arts)
hero.subtitle: Cultivating Social Well-being, Balance & Harmony
hero.description: A diverse creative hub designed to enhance brain plasticity, cognitive focus, coordination, and physical poise. Experience the beautiful intersection of Fine Arts, Slalom Skating, and Chess.

fineArts.title: Fine Arts Studio
fineArts.description: Unleash your creativity and master visual expression. From classical commissions to contemporary classes, explore art in its purest forms.
fineArts.classesIntro: We offer professional, structured fine arts classes across a wide range of mediums including Pencil & Pen sketching, Oil paints, Acrylics, Watercolors, and Oil Pastels.

skating.title: Skating & Slalom Academy
skating.description: Improve your coordination, balance, and neural plasticity through dynamic movement. We specialize in slalom freestyle training, private classes, and active brand activations.
skating.servicesIntro: Whether you want to navigate slalom cones with high precision, join as an annual member, or schedule brand-enhancing skating activations, we provide world-class training.

chess.title: Chess & Mind Sports
chess.description: Sharpen your intellect, enhance strategic thinking, and build focus. Join our chess community for private tutoring and casual or competitive board gaming.
chess.tutoringIntro: From mastering opening theories to endgame strategies, our personalized 1-on-1 tutoring sessions cater to beginners, intermediate players, and advanced competitors.

classes.title: Mastering Oil Painting
classes.description: Learn color blending, brush techniques, canvas preparation, and texture application.

classes.title: Pencil & Pen Portraiture
classes.description: Focus on anatomical accuracy, shading, facial features, and expressions.

classes.title: Slalom Freestyle Basics
classes.description: Master simple maneuvers, cross-overs, and fundamental cone drills.

classes.title: Elite Slalom & Flow
classes.description: Advanced footwork, wheeling, and seamless combo styling over speed cones.

classes.title: Strategic Opening & Middle Game
classes.description: Learn standard openings, tactical sequences, pawn structures, and positional advantages.
